g.text: In randomised trials that ran two years, 22.5% of children in programmes to get them outdoors became

text.style: font-size: 13.5px; font-family: 'Inter'; fill: #4a4741

g.text: short-sighted, against 26.7% of those without (risk ratio 0.84, 95% CI 0.72–0.98).
